text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...
Hey.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The way Fine Motion runs is... Well, it's
pretty
impressive, right?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She looks like she's having a lot of fun
out there...
Yeah, it's very nice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion does fantastic in the race,
so I'm
expecting her to come back in her
usual high
spirits. However...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That... was... so... muuuuch...
FUUUUUN! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The Classics really are amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The intensity coming off the others
racing beside
me was positively
electrifying!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to believe there are more races
like—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Are you okay? You seem kind of tense.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ehe, yeah, I guess I got too worked up!
choice_data_list: Was it because you looked like you...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But I feel absolutely tip-top! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I can see how that must have been
misleading. I
was just so happy...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But I understand.
I'll be careful not to do
anything
to worry you again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'll have no shortage of worries
in the future. But I want Fine Motion to
focus on enjoying what's right in front of
her without
troubling herself over it.
choice_data_list: Feel free to act however you like.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, now you've gone and said it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So that means you're okay with me
eating as
much ramen as I want before
training?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I just meant that I want her to forget
about her circumstances and her
surroundings and live freely in the truest
sense of the word when she's
around me.
choice_data_list: That's not quite right, is it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I know what you meant. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'm going to run to my heart's
content!
Next up is the Japanese Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I forbid you from calling me that,
Trainer! You
may call me "Fine." Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's having so much fun.
Must be
nice...

text_block_list.name: Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice getting treated like a
princess, huh?
